title: SBA (represented by AG) and America First Legal file securities class action against Target
summary: State Board of Administration, represented by Uthmeier, sued Target in M.D. Fla. for misleading investors about the market risks of its LGBTQ marketing.

title: $79 million settlement with JUUL; creates Vape Free Florida Fund
summary: JUUL pays $79M to resolve Florida's suit; $30M seeds the Vape Free Florida Fund for nicotine enforcement; youth-marketing restrictions.

title: Investigation into proxy advisers Glass Lewis and ISS over ESG/DEI policies
summary: Consumer protection/antitrust investigation of the two largest proxy advisory firms.

title: $4.1M and lifetime industry ban against deceptive moving broker enterprise
summary: Five consent judgments permanently bar defendants from operating as moving brokers; $4.14M judgments incl. $1.12M consumer relief.

title: Return of millions from Universal Property & Casualty to Florida Hurricane Catastrophe Fund
summary: AG said Universal agreed to repay $30M+ in Irma-unrelated FHCF reimbursement claims and $4M+ penalties. Universal disputed the framing, saying the matter was resolved in 2023, no new amount owed, and it denies wrongdoing.

title: Multistate suit against Nuclear Regulatory Commission to ease licensing of advanced/small modular reactors
summary: Suit asks court to vacate NRC rules and require updated standards; benefits advanced nuclear/SMR developers and utilities. (Suit vs. federal agency, included because it is industry-favorable.)

title: Subpoena to Roblox over child-protection policies
summary: Investigative subpoena for Roblox's child safety policies and age verification.

title: Lawsuit against Snap Inc. under HB 3 social-media law
summary: Suit alleging Snapchat violates HB 3 (minors' accounts, addictive features) and FDUTPA. Handled by outside counsel Cooper & Kirk on contingency.

title: No-bid contingency-fee contract with Cooper & Kirk for Snap litigation
summary: No-bid contingency contract (fees up to ~$50M) for the Snap suit; firm is described as favored by the DeSantis administration, a partner is a former DeSantis roommate, and its lawyers served on Uthmeier's transition team. Date approximate (contract tied to April 2025 suit).

title: Outside counsel contract with Boies Schiller Flexner
summary: Contract at up to $875/hr partners, $625/hr associates to defend immigration law and Alligator Alcatraz litigation; firm lawyers served on Uthmeier's transition team. Date approximate (contract file references 5.12).

title: Legal action against Contec and Epsimed over patient monitors sending data to China
summary: FDUTPA action alleging concealed backdoor and transmission of patient data to China; Epsimed is a Miami reseller of relabeled Contec monitors.

title: Investigation and subpoena to Robinhood Crypto over cost claims
summary: FDUTPA probe of 'lowest cost' claims given payment-for-order-flow model.

title: Subpoenas to CDP and Science Based Targets initiative ('climate cartel')
summary: Consumer protection/antitrust subpoenas alleging collusion in climate target-setting; favors fossil-fuel and industrial firms pressured by ESG standards.

title: Lawsuit against online pornography distributors for violating HB 3 age verification
summary: Suit to compel HB 3 age verification and FDUTPA penalties.

title: Emergency rule scheduling 7-OH (kratom derivative), removing it from store shelves
summary: Emergency rule made 7-OH a Schedule I substance; followed Sept 18, 2025 by seizure of ~18,000 products statewide and a June 2026 rule adding related compounds.

title: False Claims Act suit against McGraw Hill and Savvas for overcharging school districts
summary: State intervened in whistleblower case; seeks treble damages for alleged overcharges on instructional materials.

title: Subpoena to Lorex over data privacy and Chinese military ties
summary: Consumer protection/data privacy subpoena.

title: Complaints against pornography websites and payment processors for age-verification violations
summary: Two HB 3 complaints seeking up to $50K per violation.

title: $3 million settlement with Gilead Sciences over improper HIV drug promotion
summary: Multistate/federal Medicaid settlement; Florida Medicaid receives $3,033,238.

title: Office of Parental Rights enforcement action against Roku
summary: Florida Digital Bill of Rights action over children's data. Resolved June 26, 2026.

title: Criminal subpoenas to Roblox
summary: Criminal subpoenas over predators on the platform.

title: Lawsuit against proxy advisers ISS and Glass Lewis
summary: Suit in 14th Judicial Circuit alleging deception of investors and manipulation of corporate governance (ESG/DEI). Favors corporate management vs. proxy advisers.

title: Subpoena to TP-Link over cybersecurity and CCP data sharing
summary: Investigative subpoena; led to Oct 6, 2026 lawsuit.

title: Lawsuit against Starbucks over race-based quota policies
summary: Florida Civil Rights Act suit over DEI goals. Resolved Sept 17, 2026.

title: Lawsuit against Roblox for misrepresenting platform safety
summary: FDUTPA suit over child safety claims.

title: Suits against Central Florida smoke shops selling vapes listed on Nicotine Dispensing Device Directory
summary: Fifth Circuit complaints under FDUTPA and nicotine statutes for selling directory-listed (contraband) disposable vapes; $1,000 per device penalties. Directory enforcement removes flavored disposables from shelves, which benefits FDA-authorized brands (e.g., Reynolds Vuse, Altria NJOY) relative to illicit disposables.

title: Final consent judgments against MV Realty
summary: $18M suspended judgment ($3M due by June 30, 2026); liens removed from 9,000+ homes; principals barred 10 years from certain real estate activity.

title: Brief urging Florida Supreme Court to reject recreational marijuana amendment
summary: AG brief called the Smart & Safe (Trulieve-backed) adult-use amendment 'fatally flawed'; Florida Chamber and AIF filed supporting briefs. Date approximate (filed the Friday before Jan 5, 2026 coverage).

title: AGO 2026-01: Nassau County growth cannot justify impact fees above statutory cap
summary: Opinion (requested by Rep. Richard Gentry) holds 17% five-year growth is not an 'extraordinary circumstance' allowing impact fees above the cap; favors developers and homebuilders.

title: Subpoena to Smart & Safe Florida in criminal probe of marijuana petition fraud
summary: Subpoena plus 46 new investigations into the adult-use marijuana petition drive (committee largely funded by Trulieve).

title: Investigation into predatory pet-sale financing; cites Petland franchise consent judgment
summary: Formal consumer protection investigation into lenders and retailers offering pet financing; economic report estimates $25M/yr harm.

title: AGO 2026-03: State law preempts local shopping cart ordinances
summary: Opinion holds municipalities cannot require shopping cart retention plans or penalize retailers; favors grocery and big-box retailers.

title: Largest seizure of illegal vapes in Florida history (2,183 vapes)
summary: Vape Task Force (funded by JUUL settlement) seized contraband disposables in Clermont, Ocoee, Okaloosa and Milton; FDACS pulled 8,000+ packages; owner of Unique Vape and Cigar arrested on nitrous oxide charges.

title: AGO 2026-05: Equestrian events are agritourism; county cannot regulate
summary: Opinion holds TerraNova's equestrian competitions and temporary lodging are agritourism, so Manatee County cannot enforce building permit or site plan rules against them.

title: Jury verdict against Live Nation-Ticketmaster in antitrust case
summary: SDNY jury found illegal monopoly; estimated $1.72/ticket overcharge.

title: Civil investigative demands to consumer-goods companies and plastics groups over antitrust collusion
summary: CIDs probe whether companies colluded with environmental groups to restrict 'problematic' plastics; benefits plastics/petrochemical producers.

title: Criminal investigation into OpenAI/ChatGPT
summary: Criminal investigation and subpoenas; followed by June 1, 2026 civil suit.

title: Subpoena to JEA over canceled lobbying contract (Ballard Partners)
summary: Subpoena for records on the lobbying deal JEA's CEO canceled; date approximate (reported Apr 24, 2026).

title: First state lawsuit against OpenAI and CEO Sam Altman
summary: FDUTPA suit over deceptive practices and harms; temporary injunction sought Sept 28, 2026.

title: No intervention in FPL's ~$7B rate case (or Duke/TECO)
summary: Florida Phoenix reports Uthmeier, unlike prior GOP AGs, did not intervene in FPL's rate case approved Nov 2025; his PAC took a $5,674 in-kind contribution from FPL in April 2025. Inaction, not a formal act.

title: Subpoena to CVS Health and Caremark over anticompetitive practices
summary: Antitrust subpoena.

title: Resolution with Roku of digital privacy enforcement action
summary: Roku adds parental controls (~$25M engineering cost); no fine, no finding of wrongdoing.

title: Civil subpoena to FICO for alleged anticompetitive practices
summary: Antitrust subpoena.

title: Subpoena to General Mills over potassium bromate
summary: FDUTPA subpoena on bromated flour products. Expanded Oct 16, 2026 with subpoena to distributor Performance Food Group.

title: Demand to New York Times corporate board; Sept 23 petition to inspect books and records
summary: Shareholder-style demand followed by a Sept 23, 2026 petition to inspect corporate books and records.

title: Lawsuits against sweepstakes casino operators VGW and Stake and their payment processors
summary: Hillsborough Circuit suits under gambling law and FDUTPA seeking forfeiture, restitution, penalties; benefits licensed gaming (incl. Seminole Tribe's exclusive online sports betting) by targeting unlicensed competitors.

title: Investigative subpoena to KIS Consulting over inspection/referral practices
summary: Probe of door-to-door solicitation and referral fees to attorneys/engineers for construction defect claims; framed as protecting homeowners (and condo/insurers) from claim costs.

title: $1.2 million settlement with Deloitte over DEI practices
summary: Deloitte pays Florida $1.2M (part of $21.5M DOJ resolution) over race/sex-based staffing while certifying equal-opportunity compliance on state contracts.

title: Antitrust suit against PBMs Prime Therapeutics and Express Scripts
summary: Polk County suit alleging horizontal price-fixing.

title: Legal action against Netflix over children's data
summary: Deception and children's data harvesting claims.

title: Joins FTC and 21 states suing Amazon over ad surcharge scheme
summary: W.D. Wash. complaint under FDUTPA.

title: Resolution of Starbucks lawsuit
summary: Starbucks pays $1M for costs, certifies FCRA compliance for 4 years; no admission of wrongdoing.

title: Suit against insulin makers, PBMs and rebate aggregators
summary: Eleventh Circuit suit under FDUTPA and Florida Antitrust Act over insulin and GLP-1 pricing.

title: Consumer protection suit against Evolve Construction for preying on hurricane victims
summary: Suit against company and principals over post-hurricane contracting.

title: Lawsuit against Pfizer and CEO Albert Bourla over COVID vaccine claims
summary: FDUTPA suit alleging misleading vaccine safety claims.

title: Lawsuit against TP-Link Systems
summary: Suit alleging hidden China ties and security flaws.

title: Temporary injunction motion against Meta after rejecting multistate settlement
summary: Pasco County motion seeking age verification, under-14 removal, curfew and usage caps; Florida declined the ~$17-18B nationwide Meta settlement.

title: Lawsuit against Discord over child safety
summary: Suit follows March 18, 2026 investigation.

title: Subpoena to Performance Food Group over bromated flour
summary: Expanded potassium bromate probe; names Pillsbury and Gold Medal bakery flour brands.

title: Investigation of homeowners insurers for banning public adjusters; subpoena to Velocity Risk
summary: Antitrust probe of 'anti-public adjuster' policy clauses; subpoena seeks trade group and inter-insurer communications. Adverse to insurers, favorable to public adjusters.
